Owner(s).note: A trade press article on the plant's citizen investment offer says both the Römerbrücke power plant and the new gas engine plant belong to Energie SaarLorLux, based in Saarbrücken. The company itself is held 51 percent by Engie Deutschland and 49 percent by Stadtwerke Saarbrücken, according to its own website. GEM lists the company that holds the plant, so the existing owner is right.

Latitude.note: The city of Saarbrücken tourism page lists the Römerbrücke power plant at Bismarckstraße 143, 66121 Saarbrücken. A map lookup of that site gives about 49.2234 north and 7.0155 east, roughly 50 meters from the point GEM holds. So the existing coordinates match the plant site. The page does not print coordinates itself.
